pages.text: Checks if a door, trapdoor or fence gate is open.$(br2)Any other block raises INVALID_ARGUMENT. An empty $(1)dimension$() in the position means the dimension of the trigger block.
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the door is$(li)result $(1)result$() BOOLEAN: true if it is open
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/GET_OPEN$(br)  PARAMETER position door ;$(br)  RESULT result isOpen$()
